facts.claim: Abi 用钥匙打开假铁门，抽开门闩
facts.quote: She produced a key and inserted it into the lock, drawing back the bolt.

facts.claim: Abi 进门后从内侧再用同一把钥匙把门锁上
facts.quote: she locked it again from the inside, which required using the same key.

facts.claim: Abi 握住当门把手的铁环，慢慢拧开正门
facts.quote: Abi grasp the iron ring that served as a door handle and twist it slowly

facts.claim: Dan Caraway 指着自己向叙述者自报姓名
facts.quote: “Dan Caraway!” the man boomed, indicating himself.

facts.claim: Dan 与叙述者握手时用力过猛
facts.quote: he would use too much pressure, and I was right.

facts.claim: Seth 上前把琴夹到左臂、把弓换到左手，再与叙述者握手
facts.quote: Seth Caraway stepped forward, pausing to tuck his violin under his left arm

facts.claim: Genevieve 走来把手放进叙述者掌心并握了握
facts.quote: She slipped her hand inside of mine and squeezed it.

facts.claim: Abi 用空着的手把 Seth 拉进她与 Genevieve 的拥抱
facts.quote: grabbed Seth Caraway with her free hand and pulled him into their embrace

relations.rel: 自五岁起相识的挚友，一同经历过劫难
relations.quote: These two friends who’d known each other since they were five years old
he had to be Seth Caraway, Genevieve’s son
The tall man I’d already identified as Seth’s father

relations.rel: 夫妻，Dan 婚后退出特技行业
relations.quote: Dan had retired from stunt work soon after marrying Genevieve.

relations.rel: Abi 是带叙述者来见客户的中间人，向 Genevieve 打包票
relations.quote: “Oh, Belle can handle anything I’m serving.” Abi moved past me

numbers.claim: 叙述者强调大门是双向锁：内外都能上锁或开锁
numbers.quote: be one hundred percent clear that the door featured a double lock

numbers.claim: 门旁墙上嵌了九块瓷砖，拼出 SWEET SPOT
numbers.quote: a cluster of nine tiles had been embedded in the wall next to the door

numbers.claim: 全家人到齐，共七人聚在这间大屋里
numbers.quote: they were all assembled, all seven of them, in this cavern of a room

numbers.claim: 钢琴长约九英尺，是居家环境里见过最大的
numbers.quote: easily a nine-footer, a piano fit for a concert hall

numbers.claim: Seth 十四岁，是屋里唯一的孩子
numbers.quote: I knew he was fourteen because he was the only child in the room

numbers.claim: 叙述者凭猜测会说 Seth 有十八岁
numbers.quote: If I’d been guessing, I would have said he was eighteen.

numbers.claim: 《Beethoven》系列从 1990 年代初起拍过八部真人电影
numbers.quote: in eight (no, really) live-action movies beginning in the early 1990s

numbers.claim: 多年间有四只不同的圣伯纳犬出演那个角色
numbers.quote: there were actually four different Saint Bernards who played the role

numbers.claim: Swole Squad 的人数视视频而定，从十人到五十人不等
numbers.quote: which was anywhere from ten to fifty people depending on the video

numbers.claim: 《Vice Versa》是 1988 年由 Judge Reinhold 与 Fred Savage 主演
numbers.quote: I’m partial to Vice Versa from 1988 starring Judge Reinhold and Fred Savage

numbers.claim: Abi 与 Genevieve 自五岁起就认识
numbers.quote: known each other since they were five years old

numbers.claim: Dan 在不到十五秒内就提到了夫妻收入差距
numbers.quote: in less than fifteen seconds, he had brought up this disparity

numbers.claim: 叙述者自十八岁离开后再没回过这一带
numbers.quote: I hadn’t been back to this part of the world since I was eighteen. Not once.

numbers.claim: Dan 两条手臂上都是整袖纹身
numbers.quote: I observed two full sleeves’ worth on his naked arms

numbers.claim: 中轴小路两侧各有一条相对而设的长凳
numbers.quote: one of two benches facing each other

turning_point: 拉小提琴的不是 Genevieve，而是她十四岁的儿子 Seth；章末叙述者又看穿这家人的亲密是“用力过猛”的表演
notes: 不确定：本章无明确日期，1988/1990s 均为影片年份；Seth 年龄仅有叙述者推断（他说“fourteen”，又自承若猜会说“eighteen”）；“fifteen seconds”是叙述者估数；Beethoven 电影的“八部/四只狗”为作者夹注，未核外部资料。
